summary: Tested MyCareerCopilot Admin Dashboard - all 19 backend tests passed (100%) and all frontend tests passed. Admin endpoints properly secured with 403 for non-admin users. Dark theme sidebar layout with 5 nav items working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard fully tested. Admin user (fuzailbukhari@gmail.com) has role='admin'. Non-admin users get 403 on all /api/admin/* endpoints and are redirected from /admin to /dashboard. Ban/unban creates audit logs. Subscription override sets subscription_override=true flag.

GET /api/admin/overview.details: Returns total_users, mrr, active_users_24h, failed_logins_24h, locked_accounts, signups, usage_this_month

GET /api/admin/users.details: Returns paginated user list with search, plan filter, status filter support

GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}.details: Returns user, profile, usage, app_count, saved_jobs_count, recent_activity

POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/ban.details: Bans user, deletes sessions, creates audit log

POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/subscrip.details: Overrides subscription to pro/free, sets subscription_override flag

GET /api/admin/security/summary.details: Returns failed_logins_24h, failed_logins_7d, locked_accounts, banned_users, top_offending_ips

GET /api/admin/audit-logs.details: Returns paginated audit logs with type filter support

GET /api/admin/audit-logs/types.details: Returns distinct log types for filtering

GET /api/admin/support/search.details: Returns matching users by email/name (min 2 chars)

POST /api/admin/support/send-notificatio.details: Sends notification to user, creates audit log

GET /api/admin/users/export/csv.details: Returns CSV file with user data

Non-admin 403 access control.details: test@demo.com correctly gets 403 on all admin endpoints

Frontend /admin layout.details: Dark theme sidebar (bg-gray-950) with 5 nav items: Overview, Users, Security, Audit Logs, Support

Frontend /admin/users.details: User table with search, plan filter, status filter, export CSV button

Navbar Admin Panel link.details: Visible only for admin users (role='admin'), hidden for non-admin
